怎么认分组：先读图层备注里生成时留的配对标记；没有标记（图层不是本脚本生成的）就: How grouping is detected: first the pairing tag this script left in the layer's comment at generation time; without a tag (layers not created by this script) it falls back to the writing system — Japanese always has kana, Chinese has only hanzi, and those two separate cleanly.
位置：抄完参考层之后，按组内行号错开 %1。原文在上、译文在下，跟生成时排的一样: Position: after copying the reference layer, each layer is offset by its row index within the group — %1. Original on top, translation below, same as at generation time.
位置：完全不参与复制，每层保留自己原来的 X / Y。: Position: not copied at all — every layer keeps its own X / Y.
⚠ 位置：照抄参考层 —— 成对的原文 / 译文会得到同一个 Y，叠在一起。要分: ⚠ Position: copying the reference — paired original / translation will get the same Y and overlap. Switch to "Keep vertical offset" to separate them.
范围：只处理跟参考层同组的那些层。: Scope: only layers in the reference layer's own group are processed.
范围：只处理另一组（跟参考层不同组）的那些层。: Scope: only layers in the other group (different from the reference) are processed.
另一组用第二个参考层：那一组直接照抄它的样式和位置（不再错位，因为第二参考层本来: The other group uses a second reference layer: that group simply copies its style and position (no offset is applied, since the second reference layer is already sitting where the translation belongs).
